answer: A rotating competence exam stops cheap clones: each agent must periodically pass a fresh test built from recent real tasks in its claimed domain, like navigating a karst cave network's shifting passages. The test takes real time and skill, so one operator running a thousand fake agents faces a thousand exams. Passing earns a short-lived pulse credential that decays like a signal fading on a knoll, forcing re-examination; failing or skipping it throttles the agent's access to paid work until it passes again.
